quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large passenger train has derailed at moderate speed on a curve, with several carriages on their side. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given the scale of the derailment.
quests.explanation: Several carriages affected means several rescue teams are needed to search and free passengers at the same time.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Passengers in one overturned carriage cannot open the doors, which are now facing upward. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what rescuers must create to reach trapped passengers.
quests.explanation: Cutting a new exit lets rescuers reach passengers safely when the normal doors can no longer be used.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All passengers have been accounted for, with most injuries described as minor. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what process should start once everyone is safe.
quests.explanation: An investigation afterward finds exactly what caused the derailment, helping prevent a similar incident in future.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional dam's monitoring system detects an unusual crack forming after months of drought followed by sudden heavy rain. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who must assess the crack right away.
quests.explanation: Immediate engineering assessment determines exactly how serious the crack is before any wider warning is issued.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the crack is serious enough to warrant warning towns downstream, just in case. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the cautious type of alert appropriate here.
quests.explanation: A precautionary warning prepares downstream residents without causing the panic a full evacuation order might.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Repairs are completed and engineers confirm the dam is fully safe under normal conditions. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the earlier warning.
quests.explanation: Lifting the warning once repairs are confirmed reassures downstream residents that the dam is genuinely sound again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large university's main library has a fire alarm during exam season with over a thousand students studying inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the method that avoids a crush on the stairs.
quests.explanation: A floor-by-floor evacuation avoids overwhelming the stairwells all at once, which is safer with this many people.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fire crews confirm a faulty sensor triggered the alarm and there is no actual fire. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the alarm is confirmed false.
quests.explanation: Confirming there's no fire first means students return to a library that's genuinely safe, not just quiet.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The library's fire safety officer requests the faulty sensor be replaced before term continues. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what practical next step should be arranged.
quests.explanation: Scheduling the repair prevents the same false alarm from disrupting exams again in the coming weeks.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A coastal town's sea defenses are eroding faster than expected, threatening a row of homes within days. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the early-stage instruction before a full evacuation is needed.
quests.explanation: Early advice gives residents time to pack important belongings before a more urgent evacuation becomes necessary.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the erosion has reached a critical point and the homes are no longer safe. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the stronger action now needed.
quests.explanation: A full evacuation now reflects the confirmed critical risk, moving beyond the earlier precautionary advice.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency coastal defenses have been installed and engineers confirm the immediate risk has passed. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what limited action can now be permitted.
quests.explanation: A cautious return respects that the underlying erosion risk hasn't disappeared, even though the immediate danger has eased.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A major shopping district reports a fire spreading between three connected buildings via a shared roof space. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how firefighting resources should be spread across the buildings.
quests.explanation: Sending crews to each building at once stops the fire being fought at only one point while it spreads through the others.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters need to stop the fire from spreading further along the shared roof space. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the technique used to physically stop fire spreading.
quests.explanation: Cutting a break in the roof removes the fuel path, physically stopping the fire from reaching the third building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is contained to two buildings and the third is confirmed undamaged. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what process should start once the fire is out.
quests.explanation: An assessment tells shop owners and engineers exactly what repair work each affected building now needs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large agricultural show reports a barn fire with livestock trapped inside during a busy weekend event. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: A fast response gives the best chance of putting the fire out before it spreads through the whole barn.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Show organizers need visitors moved well clear of the barn while crews work. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with the crowd nearby.
quests.explanation: Moving visitors back keeps them safe from smoke and heat while firefighters focus on the barn itself.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters manage to lead most of the livestock out safely before the fire is fully out. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for help trained to check on the animals.
quests.explanation: A veterinary team can check the rescued animals for smoke inhalation and treat any injuries.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large indoor arena's air conditioning has failed during a summer event, and heat is becoming dangerous for the crowd. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to improve airflow and access.
quests.explanation: Opening every exit improves airflow through the building and gives anyone feeling unwell a quick way out.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff report several attendees showing signs of heat exhaustion near the front of the crowd. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what facility should be created nearby.
quests.explanation: A cooling station with water and shade gives staff a dedicated place to treat several people at once.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers restore the air conditioning and organizers confirm conditions inside are safe again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once conditions are confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Resuming only after confirmation means the crowd isn't returned to the same dangerous heat that caused the problem.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large distribution warehouse fire threatens to spread to an adjacent building storing medical supplies. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the priority given what's stored next door.
quests.explanation: Protecting the medical supply building is a priority, since losing it could affect hospitals relying on that stock.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crews position a water curtain between the two buildings to stop the fire jumping across. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what ongoing action keeps the second building safe.
quests.explanation: Keeping the water curtain running continuously is what actually prevents the fire from reaching the second roof.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The original warehouse is a total loss, but the medical supply building is confirmed undamaged. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be verified given what was at stake.
quests.explanation: Confirming the supplies are intact reassures hospitals that their stock wasn't affected by the fire next door.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city's main water pumping station has failed during a heatwave, cutting pressure to a large residential district. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be sent while the station is repaired.
quests.explanation: Tankers provide an immediate water supply to residents while engineers work on restoring the pumping station.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Vulnerable residents, including those needing water for medical equipment, must be identified and prioritized. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which residents should receive water first.
quests.explanation: Prioritizing vulnerable households ensures those who need water most urgently aren't left waiting behind everyone else.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the pumping station is fully repaired and water pressure is back to normal. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the temporary water supply now.
quests.explanation: Standing the tankers down once normal pressure returns frees them to respond to the next water emergency.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large concert hall reports a bomb threat called in just before an evening performance with two thousand seats sold. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how the large audience should leave.
quests.explanation: A calm evacuation for a threat like this avoids the crush that a panicked rush toward the exits could cause.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Specialist teams need to search the building thoroughly while the audience waits at a safe distance. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist team trained to search buildings.
quests.explanation: A trained search team can check the building systematically and safely, which untrained staff should never attempt.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The search finds nothing, and the threat is assessed as not credible after a thorough check. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the building is confirmed clear.
quests.explanation: Allowing the audience back only after a full, confirmed search lets the evening safely continue.
